# Calorie

Calorie is a private, mobile-first food, water, and weight journal.

## Public surface

- [Calorie](https://calorie.significanthobbies.com/) explains the product, optional Google sign-in, and native Apple account linking.
- The signed-in app logs reusable foods, calories, carbs, protein, fibre, water, and weight.
- Timing estimates are deterministic and link to the [Mifflin-St Jeor energy equation](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/2305711/) and other published methodology inside the app.

## Private surface

- `/api/` is authenticated and should not be crawled.
- Individual user logs and profiles are never public.
